title: China Overtook Japan In The Car Export Race
source: China Association of Automobile Manufacturers (CAAM) and Japan Automobile Manufacturers Association (JAMA) annual vehicle export totals, as reported by Reuters, CNBC and Just Auto on China overtaking Japan as world's top vehicle exporter in 2023. China (CAAM, million units): ~0.9 (2017) and ~1.0 (2019), a decade-long plateau per CAAM commentary, then 2.02 (2021), 3.11 (2022), 4.91 (2023), 5.86 (2024). Japan (JAMA, million units): 4.71 (2017), 4.82 (2019), 3.82 (2021), 4.2 (2022), 4.42 (2023), 4.22 (2024).
